free_tier.stated: CNY 35 per month as a limited-time price against CNY 50 list, for the US CN2 GIA basic plan: 1 core, 1 GB RAM, 20 GB SSD, 500 GB of traffic a month, one dedicated public IPv4. A CNY 2 one-day trial exists with 1 core, 1 GB, 10 GB SSD and 1 GB of traffic. The page's third block offers further plans from CNY 25 a month without naming their shape. The vendor sells the same catalogue for Hong Kong, Taiwan, Korea, Japan, Vietnam, Singapore, the United States, Germany and the United Kingdom. Order page read 2026-11-07: the cart refuses both the plan and the trial as out of stock, and the cart-side product card prices the basic plan per quarter against a struck list; no annual figure is printed on any page read.
